source: Wynes & Nicholas (2017), Environmental Research Letters; perceived effectiveness from Ipsos Perils of Perception: environment (2021)
note: impact_t = tonnes CO2e saved per year by one person in a developed country (study central estimates). perceived_rank = order in which the public places the action when asked which choices cut the most emissions (1 = seen as most effective). one-fewer-child figure is contested (it books descendants' lifetime emissions to the parent) and is shown only as an annotation, not a bar.
